//: Frontend-only deployment. The Express API is hosted separately (see render.yaml) because it needs a persistent process, a MySQL connection pool and a writable uploads directory — none of which serverless functions provide.

rewrites.//: Client-side routing: every path must serve index.html, or a refresh on /products returns 404.

headers.//: This app is a till: it has no reason to read a camera other than for barcode scanning, and no reason to touch location, microphone or payment APIs.
index.html must never be cached, or users keep loading a stale bundle after a deploy.
